The '''Republic Landing Zone''' was a landing zone captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[CZ-198]],<ref name="Daily" /> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref> that served as a testing ground and [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Titans of Industry">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Landing Zone appears in the CZ-198 daily area as part of the Game Update 2.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="Titans of Industry" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
